text:
You do not have to feel like following up.

Open the message, type two lines and send it, because the customer cannot tell what mood you were in.

If your AI phone assistant pauses in an odd place when it reads out an appointment name, look at the end of that name in your booking system.

There may be a blank space there that nobody can see.

Delete it, because the voice can treat it as a pause.

You can see how much of your Claude limit you have used without typing a command.

Claude Code's docs say its status line can show the percentage for the 5 hour window and the weekly one.

It appears after the first reply, on Pro, Max and Ultra.

Tell your client the bad news in the same hour you find it.

They can plan around a problem, but they cannot plan around silence.

I read 35 reviews that people left after buying an automation.

12 praised it for working as expected on their real data, and 8 praised the builder for understanding what they needed.

Only 1 mentioned an alert for when something fails.
